name: Employ Elements
body:
School evocation [see text]; Level druid 0, shaman 0, witch 0

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range 0 ft.

Effect elemental effect

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You create a minor elemental effect based upon which of the five elements you invoke as follows:

Earth: You can move a 5-ft. cube of dirt from one spot to another spot within 5 feet or you can mold mud or wet clay into a crude shape or words.
Fire: You can ignite a small flammable object like a campfire or torch or create a small floating flame that remains with you for 1 minute.
Metal: You can clean a metal object of staining or rust or make the sound of a ringing bell.
Water: You can create up to 2 gallon of potable water per level or create a nice, cooling mist
Wood: You can make a plant germinate, create a dramatic swirl of leaves, or polish a wooden object.

This spell gains the relevant descriptor based on which element is employed.
